column1: # igCriMovieCodec's virtual slots, the igObject field hooks they chain to, and the error report it calls.
# igObject slot 1 is the hook igObject_ConstructFields calls after constructing the field values, slot 2
# the hook igObject_DestructFieldValues calls before destructing them, slot 11 the hook
# igObject_ResetFields calls after resetting them (the same slot as igViewerGuiFactory's resetFields).
# The codec slots are named by what the movie manager and renderer call them for
# (docs/engine/cri-movie-codec.md); 0x308320 is the level-1 ("ERROR") sibling of igReportNotice.
